meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解释任意提示的含义与作用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在终端界面看到提示却想知道它的实际用法。
copy.tagline_en: Explain the meaning and purpose of any tip you see.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you come across tips in a text interface and want to know what they really mean.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 解释 senpi 提示时不再只念原文：它会先核对真实提示列表与该用户的设置，再读实现代码，用提问者所用的语言给出该提示背后的具体机制，并标注代码路径。
howto.when: 当用户询问某条 senpi 提示的含义、某条提示提到的功能是怎么工作的，或自己能看到哪些提示时触发。

say.text: 刚才那条 Tip: 提示是什么意思？
say.note: Claude 会先弄清是哪个提示，再深入解释其真实机制。

say.text: 我当前能看到哪些提示？
say.note: 它会核对你的设置与状态，列出你实际会遇到哪些提示。

say.text: 那条提示提到的功能到底是怎么运作的？
say.note: 它会去读代码，用你提问的语言说明背后的实际做法。

howto.what_en: In response to tip questions, Claude no longer just repeats the tip text: it checks the live tip list and the user's settings, reads the code, and explains the actual mechanism in the user's language, citing file paths.
howto.when_en: It triggers when the user asks what a particular tip means, how a featured capability works, or which tips are available to them.

say_en.text: What did that Tip: line just mean?
say_en.note: Claude will resolve which tip it is and explain it in depth.

say_en.text: Which tips can I see right now?
say_en.note: Lists which tips you can see, after checking your settings.

say_en.text: How does the feature mentioned in that tip work?
say_en.note: Reads code and explains real mechanics in your language.
